99
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, March 22, 2018/Chaitra 1, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Housing
and Urban Affairs; Human Resource Development; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Social Justice and
Empowerment; Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 15
Extending benefits of MDMS to
private schools
*286. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether mid-day meals is cooked
and delivered in a safe and hygienic
manner in schools covered under the Mid
Day Meal Scheme (MDMS);
(b) the number of children getting the
benefit of the scheme; and
(c) whether the benefit of the scheme
has been extended to private schools and
if not, the reasons therefor?
Reservation for admissions in CEIs
†*287. SHRI RAM NATH
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the target of 27 per cent
reservation quota for admission of Other
Backward Classes in Central Educational
Institutions (CEIs) is being achieved;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the quota of reservation, as
laid down by Government, is being
followed by all the States and if so, the
details thereof?
Benefits of reservation to needy
SCs/STs
*288. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the affluent and advanced sections of SCs/
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

100
STs snatch away the maximum benefits
and the 95 per cent members of these
communities are at a disadvantage, as they
do not avail the benefits of reservation
given to them by the Central and State
Governments;
(b) if so, Government's reaction
thereto; and
(c) whether Government proposes to
extend the benefits of reservation to the
people who are in actual need and if so, in
what manner and by when it would be
implemented?
Implementation of Sexual
Harassment of Women at
Workplace Act, 2013
*289. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the status of
implementation of the Sexual Harassment
of Women at Workplace (Prevention,
Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013;
(b) the reasons for not notifying
district officers and setting up of nodal
agencies as well as redressal mechanisms
at the district level by many State
Governments and UTs, as envisaged under
the Act; and
(c) the details of States where this Act
has not been fully implemented yet?
Financial assistance to NGOs for
PVTGs
*290. SHRI MAJEED MEMON: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that fly-by-night
NGOs have drawn huge amounts under
various schemes for overall development
of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups
(PVTGs) but have done little on the
ground;
(b) if so, the steps taken by
Government in this regard;
(c) the details of financial assistance
provided to NGOs for running educational
and technical training centres for the tribals
during each of the last two years and the
current year, S tate/UT-wise, particularly
in Maharashtra; and
(d) the number of educational centres
recognised and proposals pending for
approval during the said period, State/UT-
wise?
Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat
†*291. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
has started a campaign named Ek Bharat
Shreshtha Bharat for cultural exchanges
among States with the aim to promote
cultural traditions and national integrity
of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the works under the
campaign are being undertaken as per the
expectations and with success; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Applicability of RERA on construction
irregularities
†*292. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Real
Estate (RERA) (Regulation and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Development) Act, 2016 (RERA) is not
applicable to the issues related to the
irregularity in construction of flats by
Government and delay in granting its
possession to customers, including other
such issues;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the details of provisions
providing for taking action against
authorities set up for the development of
cities for the scams committed by them
and for the delay in granting possession of
flats?
Persecution of Indian female workers
in Gulf countries
*293. SHRI K.K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
complaints about persecution of female

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, March 22, 2018/Chaitra 1, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Housing and Urban Affairs; Human Resource Development;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;  Planning;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Space; Statistics
and Programme Implementation; Tribal Affairs;
Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 160
Upgradation of nuclear power plants
3041. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of nuclear power
generation capacity added during the last
three years including the current year;
(b) the goal set for the current year and
the progress made in this regard;
(c) the quantum of funds spent on
maintenance and upgradation of nuclear
power plants during the last three years
including the current financial year and the
cost per unit of power generation; and
(d) whether Government is planning to
expand the capacity of existing and new
plants to meet the growing energy needs
and if so, the details thereof?
Agreement on peaceful use of nuclear
energy
3042. SHRI DEREK O'BRIEN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government Department
has notified United Kingdom, Sri Lanka and
Singapore about the agreements on
co-operation in peaceful uses of nuclear
energy and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether the counterparts has shared
their nuclear and non-nuclear materials,
technology, etc.  with our country and if so,
the details thereof; and
(c) whether the Department has signed
any other international agreements with
foreign nations regarding the nuclear energy
during the year 2017 and if so, the details
thereof?

716
Technology adopted for nuclear
reactors
3043. DR. R. LAKSHMANAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of nuclear reactors
presently operational  in the country;
(b) whether all the reactors are using
the same technology or different
technologies; and
(c) the details in this regard?
Setting up of heavy water reactors
3044. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up heavy water reactors in the country;
(b) if so, the name of  States where such
reactors are proposed to be set up;
(c) whether any assessment has been
made regarding likely impact of rising
number of heavy water reactors on
generation of electricity; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard during
the last three years?
Funds for development of North
Eastern Region
3045. SHRI A. VIJAY AKUMAR: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the amount released by the Ministry
for the development of North Eastern
Region during the last three years;
(b) the funds which remained unutilised
and the reasons therefor;
(c) whether there is rampant corruption
in Central schemes being implement in
North Eastern States; and
(d) if so, the initiatives taken to curb
the corruption?
Strict laws by New Zealand for skilled
workers from abroad
3046. SHRI K. C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that New Zealand
has also toughened their laws for skilled
workers from abroad;
(b) if so, the details thereof and how
they are impacting Indian skilled workers;
(c) the manner in which the Ministry is
looking at these developments, first by US
then Australia and now New Zealand, which
are detrimental to our skilled workers; and
(d) whether any discussions at the
diplomatic and political level took place in
this and if so, the details thereof?
Fake agencies sending Indians abroad
3047. DR. VIKAS MAHA TME: Will
the Minister of  EXTERNAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
various agencies mostly fake in the name
of facilitating study or seeking jobs abroad
are mushrooming without any checks and
balances, charging exorbitantly high fees
from students/job applicants;
(b) if so, whether steps have been taken
by Government to contain such activities;
and
(c) if not, the steps Government
proposes to take against such agencies and
to give relief to trapped students/job
seekers?

717

SHRI A. K. SELV ARAJ:
